label: Writer
blurb: Long-form prose and copy. Voice, structure, editing passes.
_note: Runs on the pi engine on purpose: writing is a lean craft. read/bash/edit/write plus grep, with hermit's ask/attach/describe_image tools unioned in by buildModeArgs — 11 tools total, against omp's 31-tool schema which is standing context tax a pure-prose mode does not need.
Tools are read in pi's vocabulary (read/bash/edit/write/grep/find/ls — no glob). find/ls are omitted; bash covers the rare listing need.
pi engine keeps mode-local skills viable later (e.g. an editing-passes skill under skills/) — none shipped yet.
